title: SKB Verification Claim Registry Entry
description: One claim in the canonical claim registry. The registry declares WHICH claims exist, HOW they are classified, and WHAT deterministic evidence backs each one. It never carries the evidence itself -- evidence stays canonical in each repository's .repo/project.yaml and in SKB's projects/registry/. See verification/README.md and governance/VERIFICATION_AND_CLAIMS.md.

id.description: Stable, human-readable claim identity. Never reused for a different statement; a replaced statement is a new id referenced by supersedes.

class.description: evidence_backed = an objectively testable statement that automation may refresh. positioning = human-authored statement that automation must never rewrite or mark verified.

text.description: Canonical English statement. The Portfolio renders its own localized copy from this id; this text is the reviewable authority for what the claim says.

public.description: true = may appear in the public Portfolio projection. false = internal only (e.g. evidence referencing a private repository).

verification_method.description: How the claim is checked: repository_state, github_api, human_attested, or none.

supersedes.description: Claim id this statement replaces. The superseded claim keeps its record and is reported as superseded, never deleted.

note.description: Human-authored justification, required in practice for positioning/human_attested claims.
